name: Greater Mark Of Detection
description: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Mark of Detection Feat) You gain the following benefits.

Ability Score Increase.description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Improved Intuition.description: When you use the Deductive Intuition benefit of your Mark of Detection feat, you can roll 1d6 instead of 1d4.

Shared Detection.description: When you use the Magical Detection benefit of your Mark of Detection feat to cast See Invisibility without a spell slot, you can choose one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself. That creature also gains the benefits of the spell for its duration.
